test_python_tokenizer: test the Python tokenizer by tokenizing source code and comparing output tokens against expected token lists
test_python_detokenizer: test the Python detokenizer by round-tripping code through tokenize then detokenize and verifying tokens match
test_extract_functions: test extracting standalone and class methods from tokenized Python source code using a language processor
test_python_tokenizer_with_coms: test the Python tokenizer with comments preserved by passing keep_comments=True and comparing token output
test_python_dont_process_strings: test the Python tokenizer without processing string contents by passing process_strings=False and comparing token output
